review.basis: At candidate commit 549ef11, /agents/:id/keys already calls getAccessibleAgent before listKeys; getAccessibleAgent resolves the agent and enforces assertCompanyAccess. The selected direct child leaves that endpoint guard unchanged.

review.basis: The candidate uses Object.assign on the request body before repository.save; the inspected fix replaces it with an allowlist and enforces the workspace ID server-side.
